atoms.text: Matsuo Bashō was born in Japan in 1644. That’s over 350 years ago! He lived during the Edo period and is considered to be the greatest master of haikus. Haikus are a famous type of short Japanese poem. For part of his life, Matsuo Bashō was a teacher, but then he moved to the countryside to write. His poetry was inspired by the world around him and was often about nature.
